newsitem.title: POLAND: KGHM may have upside after debut-analysts.
newsitem.headline: KGHM may have upside after debut-analysts.

text.p: Polish coppper giant KGHM Polska Miedz's debut on the Warsaw bourse on Thursday at 23.5 zlotys, 11.9 percent above its institutional investor issue price, surprised analysts, who were divided on the stock's future.
Some said KGHM's 115.8-million-zloty turnover on Thursday, nearly half of the main market's turnover, signalled the stock could extend gains despite relatively high market ratios.

"The scale of the turnover might attract some of the less decided, especially foreign investors, as they know most firms on the bourse have very low liquidity and don't attract foreign portfolio investors," one trader said. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
